title: Round 33's net2, trained reading net1 v7's traffic head, against round 29's net2 on validation links
description: Round 33 (exp-net2-r33-traffic-302) trained round 29's DAgger gate3 students again, three seeds, with net2 reading the probabilities of net1 v7's traffic head (release model-net1v7-traffic-head, 0.893 balanced accuracy on unseen links; exp-traffic-head-v7-300) beside net1 v7's means. Taken untrained into round 29's actors the head gained 0.38 to 0.52 among copies and lost 0.045 to 0.055 on the five-family mean (exp-traffic-head-val-301). This runs each seed of round 33 at iteration 39 (net2-r33), the iteration round 29 was chosen at, beside round 29's students with their own beliefs (net2-v7), the same students with both beliefs from the head (net2-v7hp, run 301's better arm) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7), all thresholds at 0.5, on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies. Reading, stated before the results: net2 learns to use the head if net2-r33 gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean, both over three seeds.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; echo "62043107ace9c7c3c913124f42d26023474ec6108cc59d959475da6bd57820be  $H" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hp-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/traffic_head.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter039/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cmp "$e/traffic_head.pt" "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33-s$s" "$e" --t 0.5; for a in v7 v7hp r33; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 20 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
